title: machbox plugin manifest (plugin.yml)
description:
Point editors at this schema with a first line of
# yaml-language-server: $schema=<path or URL of this file>
so that plugin.yml is not matched against unrelated schemas (e.g. Bukkit's).

manifest_version.description: Plugin contract version implemented by machbox.

requires.description: Guest requirements; checked against the baseline before boot and the live guest after. A workflow's add to the plugin's: both macos constraints apply, its sip wins, features add up.

features.description: Features the baseline must have, recorded by Machbox Setup.

env.description: Environment variables; values are templates like run arguments. A PATH is also where commands without a slash are looked up.

inputs.description: Declaration order is the positional argument order.

network.description: Guest network when machbox run has no --network. gateway-public: public addresses only.

type.description: file: a host path shared read-only with the guest; tools get its absolute guest path and copy it into the workdir to change it. boolean: true or false (default false, cannot be required); --name alone sets it.

values.description: The only values a string input accepts.

run.description: argv; ${{ inputs.<name> }}, ${{ output }}, ${{ steps.<id>.output }}, ${{ steps.<id>.status }} and ${{ plugin_dir }} are substituted. A command with a slash is resolved in the plugin directory; relative paths in arguments are relative to the workdir, so use ${{ plugin_dir }}/<path> for plugin files.

output.description: File the step writes, relative to the workdir; copied back to the job directory.

timeout.description: Go duration, e.g. 30s or 10m (default 10m). A timeout fails the step.
